title: Apache Struts2 S2-001 OGNL Injection
description: A Struts2 2.0.1 application, vulnerable to S2-001 (CVE-2007-4556): when form validation fails, the redisplayed value goes through altSyntax evaluation, so %{...} in a field runs an OGNL expression and, from there, commands.
question: Exploit S2-001 to run commands on the Struts2 server and read the flag.
